children: Big Digital Energy converted $2,568,815.71 of related-party debt into 442,899 common shares at $5.80 per share under an Exchange Agreement with Endeavor, the entity owned by its Executive Chair. The exchange closed on September 21, 2026, eliminating the outstanding principal and accrued interest under a May 28, 2026 revolving note. In a related step, the company entered a Registration Rights Agreement requiring a resale filing by October 9, 2026 and targeting effectiveness by November 17, 2026, supporting future liquidity for the holder.
